description: The open-source full-stack studio for Opus 5.5 motion video. Reverse engineering for any video. Code video with HTML: recreate, edit and render. BYOA + BYOK · Motion.md · Images, Video, Music & Voice.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: OpenMotion is a standalone npm application at the repository root. Run commands here with the Node version pinned in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. Preserve `package-lock.json` and `scripts/runtime-lock.json`; do not introduce workspace-only dependencies. Follow the [migration guide](docs/repository-migration.md), keep user data and credentials outside the checkout, and preserve third-party licenses.

Before publishing a branch, select local checks for the changed boundary. Run `npm ci` when dependencies or lockfiles change, or installed dependencies are missing or stale; otherwise reuse the existing installation.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
